persistent_writable_paths.purpose: real product config and controlled backups
product state, public orientation contract, installer state and sanitized diagnostics
product logs when explicitly enabled; raw logs are not evidence

runtime_writable_paths.purpose: temporary runtime files, IPC and disposable candidates
system runtime, F10 trigger requests and locks

special_policy_paths.selected_policy: Keep profiles in NetworkManager's native root-owned path. Normal runtime keeps root read-only. Wi-Fi changes require an explicit local configuration/maintenance window that temporarily permits root filesystem writes only for the NetworkManager apply step, then returns to read-only.
special_policy_paths.c11_2_action: Validate a reversible remount-rw window around controlled NetworkManager profile writes; never publish profile names, SSID, BSSID, IP, MAC, DNS, gateway or passwords.
special_policy_paths.rollback: Restore previous dedicated product profile from sanitized backup metadata only; never delete non-product profiles.

special_policy_paths.selected_policy: Use volatile journald for the product image. Keep product logs and sanitized diagnostics under /data/logs or /data/state. Do not persist raw system journals by default.
special_policy_paths.c11_2_action: Add a reversible journald configuration override for volatile storage and bounded runtime usage; do not delete existing logs in C11.1.
special_policy_paths.rollback: Remove the journald override and restore previous storage behavior.

special_policy_paths.selected_policy: Boot arguments are immutable during normal product runtime. Updates require explicit installer/maintenance action with backup and rollback.
special_policy_paths.c11_2_action: Verify current boot visual guardrails are stable before enabling root read-only; do not modify /boot during normal operation.

special_policy_paths.selected_policy: Systemd units and appliance files under /etc are immutable during normal runtime. Installer or maintenance refresh may open a controlled write window.
special_policy_paths.c11_2_action: Document and verify the installer/update write window; keep operator configuration outside /etc except NetworkManager profile writes.
special_policy_paths.rollback: Re-run installer rollback or restore unit backups where applicable.

special_policy_paths.selected_policy: Treat NetworkManager runtime state as volatile/system state. Persistent product network configuration remains only in NetworkManager profiles.
special_policy_paths.c11_2_action: Validate NetworkManager can operate with root read-only plus volatile /var policy.
special_policy_paths.rollback: Disable read-only policy if NetworkManager cannot recover with volatile state.

special_policy_paths.selected_policy: Treat systemd runtime state as volatile. Product state must stay in /data.
special_policy_paths.c11_2_action: Validate service state across reboot with the chosen overlay/tmpfs policy.
special_policy_paths.rollback: Disable read-only policy if systemd state persistence is required.

prohibited_runtime_write_paths.reason: appliance code is immutable during normal runtime
player code is immutable during normal runtime
generic root filesystem writes are forbidden outside explicit maintenance windows

c11_2_enablement_preconditions: validate NetworkManager profile write window without exposing identifiers
verify /data persistent paths and /tmp,/run runtime paths
verify rollback before any power-cut test
